description: This file contains Behave step definitions for managing and inspecting environment variables in test scenarios, including setting, removing, and verifying environment variables.

methods.name: step_I_set_the_environment_variable_to
methods.description: Sets a specific environment variable to a given value within a test scenario.

methods.name: step_I_set_environment_variables_with_table
methods.description: Sets multiple environment variables based on a provided table.

methods.name: step_I_inspect_environment_variables_with_table
methods.description: Inspects and verifies environment variables against expected values.

methods.name: step_the_environment_variable_exists
methods.description: Checks that a specified environment variable exists.

methods.name: step_ensure_that_environment_variable_does_not_exist
methods.description: Ensures that a specified environment variable does not exist.
